main.description: Seed GTFS-JP coverage by asking site.etzhayyim.com to crawl the gtfs.jp aggregator + transit-agency domains. WET/WAT records flow back into maps via the standard subscribeRepos pipeline; the aggregator's per-prefecture feed-zip URLs become CollectionJob rows that are then ingested by the K8s GTFS-JP dumper (see com.etzhayyim.apps.maps.bulkRefreshGtfsJp).

extraDomains.description: Optional additional transit-agency hostnames to seed beyond the default list.
